caption:
Easy Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪

What you need:
- 2 1/4 cups flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 cup butter softened
- 3/4 cup sugar
- 3/4 cup brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 2 tsp vanilla
- 2 cups chocolate chips

Steps:
1. Mix flour, baking soda, salt
2. Cream butter and sugars
3. Add eggs and vanilla
4. Combine wet and dry ingredients
5. Fold in chocolate chips
6. Drop spoonfuls on baking sheet
7. Bake 375°F for 9-11 minutes

Perfect cookies every time! #baking #cookies #recipe
